name: Ava Darlene
original_name: เอวา ดาร์เลเน่
source:
Etymology: Ava = Blooming Flower | Darlene = Beloved
Age: 17
Nationality: Rosetanian
Role: Grade 11 Student (Gifted)
Personality: Gentle yet strict with rules, a result of her upbringing. Socially adaptable and quick-witted, she reads people with ease. A natural planner and leader. Ava dislikes being called by her surname, as it makes her feel like a mere representative of her family rather than her own person.

[From in-game profile]
